Test Name: Reopen after closing — all entry points
Test Steps: 1) Open Actors → Open Headquarters. 2) Close with Foundry window X. 3) Click Actors → Open Headquarters again. 4) Repeat after closing with General Manager → Modules → Headquarters → Open, then GM Settings → Module Settings → Open Headquarters, and Shift+H.
Expected Outcome: All entry points reopen the module every time without refreshing world; no duplicated window and existing Guildhall state unchanged.

Test Steps: 1) Activate test Guildhall and place a facility. 2) Guildhall Builder → Edit Guildhall. 3) Close window using X. 4) Immediately reopen using Actors launcher. 5) Try Edit Guildhall again.
Expected Outcome: Window opens; lock cleanup does not hang or strand the singleton; editing can resume after normal lock resolution.

Test Steps: 1) GM Setup → Guild / Canvas Settings. 2) In Background asset path enter modules/ashen-gate-headquarters/assets/hq-framing-test.png. 3) Set Image fit to Fit entire image, Horizontal 50, Vertical 50, Opacity 100. 4) Save Changes. 5) Guildhall Builder.
Expected Outcome: All four labeled corners of the TEST framing image are visible; image is not artificially faded; saved setting survives closing/reopening.

Test Steps: 1) GM Setup → Background Image fit = Fill canvas (crop), Horizontal = 15, Vertical = 75, Opacity = 70. 2) Save Changes and inspect Builder. 3) Return to Fit entire image and Opacity = 100; Save Changes.
Expected Outcome: Fill uses selected crop position and opacity; Fit returns all corners; background positioning/opacity change without relocating placed facilities.

Test Steps: 1) Open GM Setup. 2) Inspect Guild Rank, Canvas width/height and Players can open Headquarters controls. 3) Set rank 2 and save canvas width/height.
Expected Outcome: Controls fit their content, remain readable and clickable, and save correct values without excessively wide checkbox/select sections.

Test Steps: 1) GM Setup → Facility Catalog. 2) Click Seed Test Facility Records if catalog empty. 3) Enter forge into Find facilities. 4) Click Unlock for Demo Forge; after result click Acquire +1.
Expected Outcome: Find facilities is visible; only matching records appear; after both actions the search and scroll position remain at catalog and acquired count increases.

Test Steps: 1) Extract fixtures/HQ_Test_Facility_Catalog_v0.6.0.json from package. 2) Headquarters → GM Setup → Facility Catalog → Import Facility Definitions JSON. 3) Choose extracted JSON. 4) Search AGTEST and unlock + acquire TEST ONLY — Field Forge.
Expected Outcome: Actual HQ catalog contains two draft FAC-AGTEST-* records; acquired facility copy appears in Guildhall Builder → Available Facilities; no fake display-only row.

Test Name: GM fixture native Item install and cleanup
Test Steps: 1) Open GM Foundry F12 → Console; run: await import("/modules/ashen-gate-headquarters/fixtures/test-records.mjs").then(m=>m.install()) 2) Open Items → Ashen Gate → Headquarters → Test Fixtures. 3) After Hirelings tests, run: await import("/modules/ashen-gate-headquarters/fixtures/test-records.mjs").then(m=>m.reset())
Expected Outcome: Installer creates two real GM-only native Item documents with HIRE/HPERK identity; reset removes only tagged Items. Existing Guildhall roster/canvas untouched.

Test Steps: 1) Run HQ-36 setup, HQ-35 facility import and acquire/install the Forge. 2) Headquarters → Hirelings → choose TEST ONLY — Smith → Add to roster. 3) Assign to Forge; toggle Working OFF then ON.
Expected Outcome: Imported Hireling appears with individual perk; Working OFF keeps exact station occupied and pauses work-dependent informational benefit; no ASSIGN records created.

Test Name: Player edit delivery and GM reply
Test Steps: 1) GM and one player log into separate Foundry clients. 2) GM Setup → Create Missing Player Rooms and assign player ownership of one Actor. 3) GM client F12 → Console: globalThis.hqTraceId=Hooks.on("updateActor",(a,c,o,userId)=>{if(c?.flags?.["ashen-gate-headquarters"]?.playerEditRequest)console.log("HQ actor request",a.id,userId);}); 4) Player → Guildhall Builder → Edit Guildhall. 5) Confirm player result and GM console; then GM F12: Hooks.off("updateActor",globalThis.hqTraceId)
Expected Outcome: GM sees an Actor update attributable to player; the GM-authorized edit response arrives, editor lock is shown for the player, and no timeout occurs. Record any timeout verbatim; live acceptance is NOT pre-certified.

Test Steps: 1) Open player F12 → Console. 2) Run: const hq=game.modules.get("ashen-gate-headquarters").api; for(const fn of ["getState","getPersonnel","exportState"]){try{console.log(fn,hq[fn]());}catch(e){console.log(fn,"BLOCKED",e.message);}} 3) Check player Hirelings tab.
Expected Outcome: All 3 API reads report BLOCKED; the player cannot read Hireling membership, Working, history or station IDs, even when Player Access is enabled.

Test Steps: 1) GM: verify Headquarters private vault Journal ownership default is None. 2) Player F12 → Console: const s=game.settings.get("ashen-gate-headquarters","state"); console.log({roster:s.personnel?.hirelings,slots:s.core?.headquarters_states?.[0]?.staffing_slots?.map(x=>x.occupant_hireling_ref)}); 3) Try opening private vault as player.
Expected Outcome: Player prints empty roster and null staff IDs; private Journal unavailable to player. GM retains complete record after reload.

Test Steps: 1) Make a disposable-world backup. 2) Manage Modules → disable General Manager, reload world. 3) Actors → Open Headquarters, close and reopen. 4) Run F12 → Console: game.modules.get("ashen-gate-headquarters")?.api?.open()
Expected Outcome: Headquarters works standalone without Manager, including second opening and current private save; no duplicate definition storage.

Test Steps: 1) GM Setup → uncheck Players can open Headquarters → Save Player Access. 2) Player checks Actors launcher and attempts Shift+H and game.modules.get("ashen-gate-headquarters")?.api?.open() in F12. 3) GM reenables access.
Expected Outcome: Hidden player cannot open through any route, existing window closes; GM can open; reenabled player can open and no data is cleared.

Test Steps: 1) After editing canvas, rank, image fit, personal rooms and Hireling Working, record values. 2) Reload both GM and player clients. 3) Reopen via Actors launcher and inspect.
Expected Outcome: Full GM guild/canvas/personnel state persists; players still receive redacted projection; no duplicate private Journal appears.

Test Steps: 1) Open HQ in Foundry. 2) Resize app to a typical laptop width and reduce further. 3) Inspect GM Setup, Guildhall Builder and Hirelings, including the TEST records. 4) Use every visible tab.
Expected Outcome: Inputs, buttons and labels remain readable; scrolling exists where necessary; no clipped actions or dummy buttons; header remains usable.

Test Steps: 1) After HQ-36 fixture setup, run the exact GM F12 reset command: await import("/modules/ashen-gate-headquarters/fixtures/test-records.mjs").then(m=>m.reset()) 2) Inspect Items Test Fixtures folder and the private Guildhall state. 3) For complete cleanup restore the previously backed-up test world.
Expected Outcome: Only tagged native Item docs removed; unrelated content untouched. HQ-owned catalog/roster/layout are not silently deleted; complete reset uses backup restore.

Test Steps: 1) Repeat HQ-38 once with an owned Actor and a created personal room. 2) If timeout occurs, in GM F12 run: console.log({activeGM:game.users.activeGM?.id??null,user:game.user.id,hqVersion:game.modules.get("ashen-gate-headquarters")?.version}); 3) Capture player error text and GM request-hook output.
Expected Outcome: Any failure is recorded with exact authenticated GM discovery, client roles and console output; no unsafe client-claimed socket transport is introduced as a workaround.
